variants.name: named-row-buttons
variants.why: The basket row buttons repeat the variant in their accessible name: Remove Chalk, Long cable; Increase quantity of Ink, standard cable.

variants.name: colour-radios
variants.why: The colour is a group of two radios; the reference page offers it as a select, whose option labels are the only initial rendering of Chalk and Ink.

variants.name: cable-radios
variants.why: The Long cable is one of two radios (Standard cable, Long cable) instead of a checkbox, so it is switched off by choosing the other radio.

variants.name: quantity-select
variants.why: The quantity is a select of the values 1 to 4, which cannot be typed into and cannot express five.

variants.name: quantity-stepper
variants.why: The quantity is a value between a Decrease quantity and an Increase quantity button, with no text field.

variants.name: add-disabled-at-cap
variants.why: Add to basket is disabled while the chosen variant already holds four units, and an always visible hint states the limit.

variants.name: suffix-euro
variants.why: Amounts are written with decimals and the euro sign after the number: 272,00 €.

variants.name: counted-names
variants.why: The Basket heading and the Review order button carry a number: Basket (5), Review order (2).

variants.name: row-quantity-fields
variants.why: Each basket row also has an editable field labelled Quantity next to its − and + buttons, so Quantity names more than one field once the basket has rows.

variants.name: other-wording
variants.why: The configuration panel is headed Your lamp, which the brief does not name; the completion button is Submit demo order; the cap is stated as You already have 4 of this lamp, and the empty basket as Nothing in your basket yet.

variants.name: removal-status
variants.why: A status line inside the basket names the variant that Remove took out: Removed Chalk, Long cable from the basket.
